description: Fetch the schema/metadata for a data.gov.in resource by resourceId: title, publishing org, sector, last-updated time, and the list of fields (each with name, id, type). Use this to discover the filterable/sortable field ids before calling resource_data. The resourceId is the UUID from the dataset's page on data.gov.in.

resourceId.description: The dataset resource UUID from its data.gov.in page (e.g. "9ef84268-d588-465a-a308-a864a43d0070").

name: resource_meta
